properties.name: grails.assets.mapping
properties.description: URL path prefix used by the asset pipeline filter and taglib.

properties.name: grails.assets.url
properties.description: Base URL for asset links. Can be a string or a request-aware closure.

properties.name: grails.assets.storagePath
properties.description: External storage path to copy compiled assets to when running in production.

properties.name: grails.assets.bundle
properties.description: Bundle assets in development instead of serving individual dependency files.

properties.name: grails.assets.useManifest
properties.description: Use manifest.properties for digest resolution when available.

properties.name: grails.assets.skipNotFound
properties.description: Skip 404 responses for missing assets when handling requests.

properties.name: grails.assets.maxCacheSize
properties.description: Most entries the asset filter's lookup cache holds in a compiled application. Zero caches none.

properties.name: grails.assets.includes
properties.description: Glob patterns of assets to include during compilation.

properties.name: grails.assets.excludes
properties.description: Glob patterns of assets to exclude during compilation.

properties.name: grails.assets.plugin.*.includes
properties.description: Plugin-specific include patterns applied during compilation.

properties.name: grails.assets.plugin.*.excludes
properties.description: Plugin-specific exclude patterns applied during compilation.

properties.name: grails.assets.minifyJs
properties.description: Enable JavaScript minification during asset compilation.

properties.name: grails.assets.minifyCss
properties.description: Enable CSS minification during asset compilation.

properties.name: grails.assets.enableSourceMaps
properties.description: Enable source map generation for compiled assets.

properties.name: grails.assets.minifyOptions
properties.description: Minifier options passed to the JavaScript or CSS minifiers.

properties.name: grails.assets.minifyOptions.excludes
properties.description: Patterns of files to exclude from minification.

properties.name: grails.assets.enableDigests
properties.description: Enable digest filename generation for compiled assets.

properties.name: grails.assets.skipNonDigests
properties.description: Skip writing non-digest files during compilation.

properties.name: grails.assets.enableGzip
properties.description: Enable gzip compression for compiled assets.

properties.name: grails.assets.excludesGzip
properties.description: File extensions excluded from gzip compression.

properties.name: grails.assets.developmentRuntime
properties.description: Enable the Grails development runtime for on-the-fly asset compilation.

properties.name: grails.assets.cacheLocation
properties.description: File path for the asset pipeline cache.

properties.name: grails.assets.digestAlgorithm
properties.description: Message digest algorithm used for asset digests.

properties.name: grails.assets.digestSalt
properties.description: Salt applied when generating asset digests.
